title: Grateful Dead Live at Max Yasgur's Farm on 1969-08-16
source: Source: sbd > 8 Track Master Reels @ 15ips (mixed by Mark Linette via Joe Gastwirt) > Dat (44k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/44.1 - Transfered by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac16; edited and mastered SIRMick November 2017

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the five‑song Woodstock set delivers solid performance with standout Dark Star, Mama Tried and High Time despite radio chatter and a brief dropout.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that presents the short festival set clearly, though occasional radio interference on “High Time” and a two‑second drop are audible. Musically the show shines on Dark Star, Mama Tried and High Time, while the extended Lovelight drags a bit and St Stephen feels truncated. Overall the performance is enjoyable and historically significant, even if not a peak Dead night.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews ranging from 3‑5 stars show generally positive impressions of both the music and the soundboard recording; average rating ~4 with detailed commentary gives high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleanest/most complete SBD source, clear overall mix; noticeable radio interference on “High Time”, a two‑second dropout around 24:10, and distortion from the guest mic during Lovelight.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief five‑song festival set with a long, meandering Lovelight; typical late‑’69 flow that balances concise numbers with an extended jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Blistering guitar tone praised, especially on Dark Star and High Time.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s keyboards described as squeezing out strange auras during the jam.
